applicabilityBasis.summary: dEURO is marketed as 1 dEURO = 1 euro and usable as a freely transferable stablecoin. Users mint against collateral, while the current site and legal memorandum describe no central issuer or repayment obligation. The protocol price target does not establish an issuer obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value; GENIUS applicability therefore remains unclear.

genius.notes: dEURO is a privately created euro-tracking crypto-asset, not euro legal tender or a central-bank liability. The dEURO Association promotes and informs about the protocol but disclaims control, so no issuerEntity is asserted. User collateral positions and market-stability incentives are not an issuer fiat-redemption policy. Savings-module returns are separate from the base dEURO token. No official token-specific GENIUS approval, application, state qualification or foreign-issuer registration was found in the opened public sources.
